combo_label: At the Seaside × At the Funfair × Castles & Medieval Life

entries.clue: Funhouse fixture that stretches and squashes your reflection
Hired singer who earned his supper retelling old heroics between courses
Diamond of fabric on a long string, flown where the breeze never drops
Victorian walkway on iron legs, striding out over the water to a pavilion
Little craft you power with your legs, hired out by the half-hour
Attendant who carried the shield and hoped one day to earn his own spurs
Little electric cars with rubber skirts, steered straight at your mates
Field labourer tied to the land, handed on with it whenever it changed owners
Leisurely seafront stroll, or the long paved strip you take it along.
Water-filled ditch that made scaling ladders useless and tunnelling a drowning risk
Sticky red coating on a fairground apple
